slides.title: A polio drive for 11 million children
slides.body: What WHO says about the campaign that began November 21

slides.title: children targeted
slides.body: In Addis Ababa, Oromia, Central Ethiopia, South Ethiopia and Southwest Ethiopia regions.

slides.title: Two rounds, door to door
slides.body: Round 1: Nov 21-24. Round 2: Dec 18-21, 2026. Health workers and volunteers visit every household.

slides.title: Why now
slides.body: WHO reports variant poliovirus type 1 cases this year in Gambella, Oromia and South Ethiopia. Ethiopia remains free of wild poliovirus.

slides.title: children reached in earlier outbreak responses
slides.body: In Gambella, Benishangul-Gumuz and parts of Oromia, WHO says.

slides.title: Finding the missed children
slides.body: Teams will also look for zero-dose and under-vaccinated children and link them to routine immunization.

slides.title: Every child should be reachable.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: WHO Regional Office for Africa, Nov 21 2026
